title: CurationDecision
description: The wire form of the settled decision on one HarvestCandidate: chapter 17's CurationDecision (MOS-TRAIN-080), physical form 0011_curation.up.sql's curation_decisions. Response body of table 10.2-B rows R2 (GET, permission harvest_candidate.read) and R3 (POST, permission curation_decision.record). Reading the decision is reading the candidate's curation state, which is why R2 takes the candidate's read permission and not a second one. The row is append-only (MOS-STORE-359, MOS-TRAIN-203): deleting an excluded row MUST be refused, so there is no PATCH and no DELETE on this resource and none is reserved.

harvest_candidate_id.description: curation_decisions.candidate_id, spelled as the path parameter of MOS-API-112 spells it.

reason_code.description: Null unless decision is exclude. MOS-TRAIN-081 aggregates these per cohort and reproduces them in any ValidationReport citing the DatasetVersion, so the value is part of the evidence and not a UI convenience.

decided_by.description: MOS-TRAIN-080's named human, as a user id. MOS-API-006 forbids the name itself in a response body.

auto_excluded_predicate_id.description: Present only on an exclusion MOS-TRAIN-080 permits to be mechanical -- gantry tilt rejected, non-uniform spacing, missing series, duplicate series_pixel_digest. Auto-INCLUSION MUST NOT be implemented, so this member can never accompany decision: include. Carried on harvest_candidates, projected here because MOS-TRAIN-080 requires the exclusion to be 'visible in the queue as an exclusion rather than an absence' and the queue reads decisions.

auto_excluded_predicate_digest.description: MOS-STORE-211's sha256_digest domain: lower-case hex prefixed sha256:. Recorded with the predicate id so the exclusion is reproducible.
